name: Evolve scenes
threading: Not thread-safe by itself: use from one thread (the plugin uses the message thread). The sequencer allocates nothing.
platforms: Any C++17 compiler. No JUCE, no host types, no audio.
standalone_test_command: cmake -S modules/scenes -B build/scenes && cmake --build build/scenes && ctest --test-dir build/scenes
summary: A bounded list of pattern snapshots (scenes) with per-scene loop counts and next/repeat/stop/jump actions, a versioned codec, and a pure sequencer that, given observed loop boundaries, says which scene plays and which scene the audio side should arm next.
limits: 32 scenes, 1 to 64 loops each, names of 1 to 32 characters, 1 MiB of serialized pattern per scene
adapters: Call `onBoundary()` once per observed pattern loop boundary and arm the returned scene in your audio engine so the switch lands on the boundary frame.
adapter_notes: Scene patterns are opaque byte blobs here; the caller decides how to serialize and restore them.
removal: Delete the folder; callers lose scene sequencing only.
